reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: handle_debt_auto_deleverage has a live non-test caller at liquidate.move:229. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json. Gate 3: both market.move and liquidate.move are in-scope. Spec INV-003 (SG-010) requires ADLBorrow to leave obligation collateral unchanged, but handle_debt_auto_deleverage unconditionally routes through liquidation_inner which calls obligation.withdraw_ctokens(seized_ctokens) at L776 — provably non-zero for any non-zero repay. The spec violation is clear; verdict is CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL (not CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY) because exploitation requires a PackageCallerCap-gated ADL operator, leaving uncertainty on whether the privileged actor is adversarial or constrained by off-chain governance.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: INV-003 (SG-010): ADLBorrow must reduce obligation debt without seizing proportional collateral from the obligation.
